name: twenty-lucky-years
why: Opens on "Your economists project two point five percent"; he swats every disaster off his straight line, rolls twenty dice, and falls through the fifth on "never had twenty consecutive years of getting lucky".

name: ai-amplifies
why: Opens on "A.I. amplifies whatever you point it at"; one robot becomes a billion attackers, the arrow turns and they become a billion researchers, ending on "You have to choose."

name: one-way-door
why: Opens on "But what if it doesn't work as well as you claim?"; the skeptic waves the nuke through and gets blown up, then walks into the painted 2.5% road, ending on the zero.
